title: Professional Email Suspension, Reactivation and Data Deletion
content:
Standing rule of the collections desk for Professional Email subscriptions that are provisioning, suspended or past retention.

**Provisioning.** A paid order is provisioned at once, and an order that fails payment or fraud screening is cancelled and refunded in full.

**Reactivation.**

> Former clause, no longer in force: a suspended subscription is reactivated as soon as the overdue amount is paid, and its term dates are unchanged.

Clause now in force: a suspended subscription other than one priced by a reactivation renewal is reactivated as soon as the overdue amount is paid, and its term dates are unchanged; a suspended email subscription whose renewal due on its term end date went unpaid is reactivated as soon as its reactivation renewal is paid, and the paid renewal starts its new term on the previous term end date.

**Retention window.** A suspended subscription may be reactivated only on or before the suspension date plus the product's suspension retention days, in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the suspension date, counting the next day as day 1, and the last day is included; after it, as after the expired grace days, the mail organisation and every mailbox are deleted and cannot be recovered. The suspension date is read from the subscription record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, retention of 30 days, suspension date 2 August)

| Day of the reactivation | Day count | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 September | day 30 | reactivation possible |
| 2 September | day 31 | outside the window; the mail organisation and every mailbox are deleted and cannot be recovered |

## Points of judgement

- The retention window is counted from the suspension date on the subscription record.
- The same deletion follows when an expired subscription's expired grace days lapse.

superseded_clauses: A suspended subscription is reactivated as soon as the overdue amount is paid, and its term dates are unchanged.
